C9000048.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 048 ('A singular normal affine surface with free tangent sheaf', unformalized in Lean), which claims to construct a characteristic-zero normal affine surface A with Der_C(A) ~= A^2 and a non-regular point (disproving the 1965 Lipman-Zariski conjecture): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/trace error, jet obstruction, or counterexample to one of the manuscript's intermediate lemmas (in 02-curve.tex, 03-trace.tex, 04-jets.tex, 05-analytic.tex, or 06-algebraization.tex) with a deterministic symbolic/computational refutation certificate, or (b) independently verify and strengthen the key algebraic/trace/jet identities with an exact machine-checkable certificate and primary-source citation audit.

CT_joint_inputs.statement: Over C, the elliptic fourth-torsion construction has a nonempty smooth fourth-contact parameter locus and simultaneously supplies all curve and residue hypotheses of the reviewed jet theorem, including one global meromorphic pair P, nonzero pole coefficients, spanning marked derivative rows, pointwise p_j wedge R_j=1, and total sum(W_j-1)=-90.
CT_joint_inputs.scope: No analytic realization, algebraization, kernel proof, novelty, or publishable significance assertion.
CT_joint_inputs.engineer_result: A simultaneous-existence proof is supplied, with a nonempty 21-dimensional fourth-contact family, one global residue-dual comparison and one global P. The exact checker passed 167 checks and 13 rejecting controls; a corrupted first-derivative identity also failed through the actual CLI.

CT_independent_review.statement: The normal independent Reviewer has read the simultaneous-existence proof, checked statement fidelity and external sources, and independently replayed the curve/trace certificate and rejecting controls.
CT_independent_review.scope_note: This completed review applies to the joint input theorem, not to the new analytic implication.

AN_analytic_endpoint.statement: The reviewed joint inputs and finite-jet theorem yield a Hausdorff analytic neighborhood, a proper contraction to a genuinely singular normal surface germ, actual holomorphic fields descending to a free full analytic derivation sheaf of rank two, trivial dualizing sheaf, discrepancy -5 and 33<=p_g<=39.
AN_analytic_endpoint.scope: Bounded analytic implication only. No algebraization, formal kernel proof, novelty or publishable-significance verdict.
AN_analytic_endpoint.engineer_result: The completed independent analytic review accepts the actual analytic germ, full holomorphic derivation frame and invariants. Its source attributions and replay are reused without repeating the audit. This records the existing receipt, not a new approval of algebraization.

AN_finite_colength_extension.statement: For a Noetherian local domain of depth at least two, an injection R^r into a finite torsion-free module with finite-length cokernel is an isomorphism. A regular-sequence argument extends its rational frame coefficients.
AN_finite_colength_extension.engineer_result: Direct proof by cancellation modulo f^N is supplied in section 8, rather than assuming a general analytic Hartogs theorem.

AN_genus_window.statement: For the constructed analytic germ, (R^1 pi_*O_Y)_x is isomorphic as a complex vector space to H1(O_(5C)), and 33<=p_g<=39. The I-adic H1 tower stabilizes at 5C; no later connecting homomorphism is assumed zero.
AN_genus_window.engineer_result: Explicit two-sided cofinal inverse-limit maps and finite-length completion identify the tower. The dimensions of the graded H1 groups are 21,12,3,2,1,0, with universal vanishing thereafter.

AN_independent_review.statement: The normal independent Reviewer accepts the new analytic proof, source applications and exact supporting certificate after independent replay.
AN_independent_review.scope_note: The completed receipt is reused for the analytic implication only. It is not approval of the new algebraization proof.

CT_GAGA.statement: For a projective complex algebraic variety X and an algebraic coherent sheaf F, the natural algebraic-to-analytic cohomology comparison maps are isomorphisms for every q>=0.
CT_GAGA.source_finding: Serre GAGA 1956, section 3, no.12, Theorem 1, p.19 was read in the primary Numdam PDF. The projective complex varieties and coherent algebraic line bundles used here meet the hypotheses. Independent attribution is pending.

M_main.statement: There exists a finitely generated normal integral C-algebra A of dimension two with Der_C(A) isomorphic to A^2 and a nonregular localization at a maximal ideal.
M_main.engineer_result: Section 10 applies the fully proved algebraization proposition to the accepted genuinely singular analytic germ. This supplies the affine existence implication, not an explicit equation list or new independent acceptance.

M_six_vectors.statement: In a nondegenerate complex quadratic plane, six nonzero vectors using three distinct nonisotropic directions twice, equal within each pair and avoiding any prescribed finite directions, can satisfy w=sum(w_j), Q(w)=90 and Q(w_j)+w_j dot w=1.
M_six_vectors.engineer_result: An exact quadratic-number-field witness replaces the small-parameter cubic argument. A one-parameter isometry excludes any prescribed finite directions while preserving all equations.

M_curve_construction.statement: For the elliptic setup and marked divisor chosen from the six vectors, a general kappa restricting to beta^4 cuts out a smooth connected curve C of bidegree (8,4), with exact fourth-order contact at Z, div_C(gamma)=4Z, and the specified normal-first adjunction isomorphism L^4=K_C for L=F|C+Z.
M_curve_construction.engineer_result: Explicit order-four elliptic torsion and a first-jet incidence bound prove a nonempty smooth open subset of the 21-dimensional affine family. Contact is exactly four; connectedness and genus follow from the product Cech calculation.

M_adjoint_jets.statement: For the constructed fourth-contact curve, H0(Sigma,A_j) identifies with H0(C,K_C-jH) and surjects onto H0(Gamma,N_j), for j=0,...,3. Length-ell evaluations on C and Gamma agree for ell<=4; the four tabulated ranks are 6,12,12,10.
M_adjoint_jets.engineer_result: The two embedded length-ell schemes coincide for every ell<=4. Complete ambient restrictions give the exact ranks 6,12,12,10; the nontrivial degree-zero torsion case is retained.

M_curve_data.statement: The construction yields smooth connected C of genus 21, reduced Z of degree 6, deg H=4, deg L=10, L=H+Z, theta=2L, normalized K_C=4L; a degree-four pencil unramified at Z with nonconstant marked values; h0(jH)=j+1 (0<=j<=3), h0(L)=h0(H+2Z)=2, h0(theta)=3, h0(O(Z))=1, h0(theta+H)=6, the stated multiplication identifications, and surjective evaluation H0((k+1)L)->H0(Z,(k+1)L|Z) for every k>=2, together with the elliptic quadratic data and vectors.
M_curve_data.engineer_result: All stated dimensions, multiplication maps, marked unramifiedness, spanning derivative rows, and evaluation for every power L^n with n>=3 are proved for the same constructed curve.

M_trace_pairing.statement: For f:C->P1 and Lambda=2L+H, f_*Lambda has the perfect symmetric trace form Tr(T1*T2/eta_C), splitting (3,0,0,-3), radical xi^2 H0(3H) on global sections and a nondegenerate two-dimensional quotient W. Local coefficient evaluation has dual square E(q)/s(q) at each q in Z.
M_trace_pairing.engineer_result: Direct trace matrices cover every degree-four ramification partition without degree averaging. The positive subbundle is nonvanishing on each fiber, and an evaluation argument plus vanishing of extension groups proves the required splitting without importing the general splitting theorem.

M_principal_parts.statement: Full double-pole principal parts induce an isomorphism iota:W->H0(Gamma,Phi) that identifies projective evaluations and whose dual is an isometry for the normalized quadratic form Q and the dual trace form.
M_principal_parts.engineer_result: One global annihilator in the common adjoint jet dual compares both double-pole coefficients. Positive normal-first adjunction and negative contact coefficient give the exact isometry scalar -E.

M_residue_data.statement: For the constructed curve and six vectors there are c_j!=0 and a global P in H0(C,L^2(Z))^2 with principal part R_j(0)/z_j, where m_j=c_j/z_j, R_j=m_j r and p_j=P-m_j r' are holomorphic, p_j(0) wedge R_j(0)=1, W_j=R_j(0) wedge R_j'(0)=(v_j*)^2, and sum(W_j-1)=-9 deg L. Also J=u wedge P has trace pairing <[J],[T]>=-sum(c_j l_j(T)), unchanged by adding holomorphic L^2 pairs to P, and the pole prescription is compatible with fourth-root coordinates.
M_residue_data.engineer_result: Duality supplies a single global P. The canonical differential P1*T/u1 proves the global pairing first, which forces all six local determinant identities and the total -90. Compatible-coordinate covariance is also derived.

M_bracket.statement: For D=t^k(b E_t+h d_z) and V=t^(ell+1)(A E_t+B d_z), [D,V] has the coefficients displayed in jets:general-bracket; div_sigma(D)=t^k((k-4)b+h'). The leading action is delta A_k=(1-k)br+hr', delta B_k=-khr.
M_bracket.engineer_result: Exact identity derivation supplied; independent review pending.

M_second_obstruction.statement: Under the exact curve and residue hypotheses, after determinant-normalized horizontal matching by volume-preserving order-one and order-two flows, all four duality tests for the order-two vertical class in H1(C,L^3)^2 vanish.
M_second_obstruction.engineer_result: All four obstruction tests derived under the stated input hypotheses; independent review pending.

M_jets.statement: For the data of prop:curve-data and prop:residue-data, finite compositions of holomorphic overlap flows of orders 1,...,7 fix C and its conormal L and admit rows A_k,B_k for 0<=k<=7 matching through index seven with A wedge B=t^2(1+O(t)). On a realization they give sections of I F/I^9 F with leading determinant t^4 E_t wedge d_z=t^5 d_t wedge d_z.
M_jets.engineer_result: Conditional implication proved in prose, including simultaneous order-three/four compatibility; input existence and independent review remain open.

M_realization.statement: After shrinking, the finite overlap germs of prop:jets realize a smooth Hausdorff surface neighborhood Y of C with conormal L, C^2=-10, two sections of F/I^9 F and the prescribed logarithmic and ordinary determinant leading terms.
M_realization.engineer_result: Section 3 proves injectivity, closedness of every graph and openness of the quotient map using buffered annuli. There are no new triple overlaps. The quotient is Hausdorff and the coefficient degrees give actual sections of IF/I^9F.

M_graded_vanishing.statement: For n>=9, H1(C,F|C tensor L^n)=0; for E=I^9 F and every r>=1, H1(Y,E/I^r E)=0.
M_graded_vanishing.engineer_result: The nonsplit logarithmic restriction sequence gives vanishing for every n>=9 by two negative-degree bounds. The finite filtration gives H1(E/I^rE)=0 for every r. The n=8 group has dimension one, proving sharpness of the graded threshold.

M_actual_lifting.statement: After shrinking Y about C, the quotient sections lift to holomorphic sections of F forming a frame of T_(Y minus C).
M_actual_lifting.engineer_result: Proper contraction, uniform I^a subset J subset I, the explicit pro-zero transition factorization, coherence, Nakayama and Stein-target vanishing yield simultaneous actual lifts. Errors in I^9F change the logarithmic wedge only in I^10 det F; compactness and proper shrinking give one unit neighborhood.

M_analytic_counterexample.statement: There is a normal complex surface germ with an isolated singular point and free analytic tangent sheaf of rank two, admitting a resolution whose exceptional set is a smooth genus-21 curve of self-intersection -10.
M_analytic_counterexample.engineer_result: Adjunction gives K_Y.C=50, contradicting smoothness of the contracted point. Actual fields extend through pi_*O_Y=O_X. The finite torsion-free analytic derivation module contains their frame with finite-length cokernel; depth two and the direct extension lemma prove full generation and extend all frame coefficients.

M_analytic_invariants.statement: The manuscript's constructed germ has trivial dualizing sheaf, discrepancy -5 and p_g>=33, with p_g-g-b>=12. This is a remark, not an independently verified theorem.
M_analytic_invariants.engineer_result: The actual dual volume, not the initial coordinate expression, has divisor -5C. The read normal-surface criterion gives trivial dualizing sheaf. The geometric-genus argument proves the stated lower bound and the additional upper bound 39.

M_finite_determinacy.statement: For P=C[[x_1,...,x_e]], I=(f), a full syzygy presentation D and finite-length T1=ker(R^s->R^t)/sum R partial_j f, sufficiently high-order compatible approximations g,B with gB=0 are formally contact-equivalent: f=Phi(g)U, with Phi identity mod n^2 and U identity mod n.
M_finite_determinacy.engineer_result: The exact quantifiers are proved with c=beta+ell+delta, N>=alpha+1 and n0>=max(c+N,c+2,2c+1). The relation precision stays fixed; equation precision increases; both coordinate and generator changes converge. B is never assumed to generate syzygies.

M_algebraization.statement: Every normal isolated complex analytic germ of dimension d>=1 with free tangent module of rank d admits a finitely generated normal integral C-algebra A and closed point p with the same completed local ring, Der_C(A)=A^d, smooth complement of p, and nonregular A_p whenever the original germ is singular.
M_algebraization.engineer_result: Sections 5-9 prove every asserted local and global property. Exact finite relations descend through henselization, the completed local ring is preserved, finite Jacobian kernels compare without identifying ordinary and continuous power-series differentials, and one principal open retains normality, dimension, a global frame and the marked singular point.

AG_fixed_step.statement: For fixed full f,D and finite-length K/J, the three Artin-Rees losses give c=beta+ell+delta, fixed N>=alpha+1 and n0>=max(c+N,c+2,2c+1). Every compatible pair at equation precision n>=n0 improves to n+1 while preserving exact zero product and relation precision N.

AG_formal_limit.statement: The cumulative substitutions and generator changes from the fixed-precision step are Cauchy, have invertible limits with identity linear/residue parts, and yield f=Phi(g)U.

AG_analytic_completion.statement: An isolated normal analytic germ has finite-length conormal-dual Jacobian cokernel; exact completion preserves its finite presentation and identifies the completed holomorphic tangent module with the continuous Jacobian kernel. The completion is a normal local domain with the same dimension and regularity status.

AG_exact_etale_model.statement: Artin approximation solves G B=0 exactly in the henselization. The finite tuple and all identities descend to one pointed etale finite-type neighborhood, whose equation quotient has the original completed local ring.

AG_tangent_descent.statement: The finite ordinary algebraic Jacobian presentation of the etale quotient completes to its continuous presentation. The formal chain rule transports kernels and faithful-flat descent gives a free algebraic tangent module of rank d.

AG_principal_shrink.statement: One principal affine neighborhood retains the marked local ring and tangent basis, is normal and integral of dimension d, and is smooth off the marked point. Nonregularity, residue field and completed local ring are preserved.

AG_equations_only_obstruction.statement: For every k>=3, adding x^k to the last twisted-cubic-cone equation changes completed dimension from two to one; the original syzygy product becomes (x^(k+1),y*x^k). This excludes equations-only approximation, not the manuscript's relation-matrix lemma.
AG_equations_only_obstruction.scope: Exact family guardrail for a retired route; not a new counterexample to prop:algebraization or thm:main.

AG_prior_art.statement: Hironaka's fixed-relation equivalence theorem and Artin's isolated-singularity algebraization already supply this method. The present result is verification of the full implication and tangent descent, not a new algebraization method.

AG_independent_review.statement: The normal independent Reviewer accepts the quantified determinacy, algebraization and main-theorem implication, checks source hypotheses, and independently replays the exact support and rejecting controls.
AG_independent_review.scope: Required for this bounded mission; no prior analytic or source-research result is approval of it.

M_log_kodaira.statement: The smooth locus of the affine surface in thm:main has logarithmic Kodaira dimension two.

M_derivation_blowups.statement: Iterated blowups of the surface in thm:main at its derivation module, with or without normalization, remain isomorphic to the original singular surface.

A_duality.statement: Serre duality on a smooth connected compact complex curve identifies H1(C,B) with H0(C,K_C tensor B^-1)^*, with overlap classes evaluated by the sum of positively oriented contour residues.
A_duality.source_finding: The original Serre 1955 Theorem 4 (p.22) and Theorem 5/corollary (p.24) were read. They supply compact-complex-manifold duality; the contour normalization is a separate derivation in the report. Independent source attribution remains pending.

A_stein.statement: On each Stein chart and overlap, coherent analytic sheaves have zero positive cohomology (Cartan B); the resulting acyclic cover computes the first cohomology used in the Cousin splittings.
A_stein.source_finding: Cartan 1951-1952, expose 18, section 4, Theorem B, original p.18-7 was read. The page image confirms q>=1; OCR incorrectly says q>1. Independent source attribution remains pending.

A_residue.statement: A meromorphic differential on a compact complex curve has total residue zero; Stokes' theorem gives the corresponding contour identity on a punctured curve and zero contour integral for dh with h single-valued holomorphic on an annulus.

A_flows.statement: A holomorphic vector field vanishing along a divisor has a time-one holomorphic flow germ, with inverse, after restricting transversely over a compact subannulus; finite compositions realize their Taylor series.

A_curve_literature.statement: Unexamined upstream inputs: Bertini for the moving linear system on P1 times P1, product cohomology on that surface, Riemann-Roch on curves, and Serre GAGA 1956 Theorem 1 for the comparison with analytic section spaces.
A_curve_literature.route_disposition: Historical manuscript-dependency inventory. The active input-existence proof replaces general Bertini with first-jet incidence, derives the needed product cohomology and Euler-characteristic formula, and separately records the read Serre-duality and GAGA propositions.

A_trace_literature.statement: External inputs in the trace section: finite-morphism duality (Hartshorne, Residues and Duality, III.6) and splitting of vector bundles on P1 (Grothendieck 1957, section 2, Theorem 2.1 and corollary). Their use in the upstream trace construction is not certified by the jet audit.
A_trace_literature.route_disposition: Historical manuscript-dependency inventory. The active input-existence proof directly proves local trace perfection and the special rank-four splitting; no appeal to these general literature theorems is needed.

A_analytic_literature.statement: Unexamined external analytic inputs: Grauert 1962 contraction (section 4.8(e), pp.366-367, and section 2); Grauert 1960 formal functions (section 6, Hauptsatze I and IIa, p.59); Demailly II.4.22 (analytic Nullstellensatz), II.3.19 and II.4.29 (coherence), II.7.8 (Hartogs), and Cartan B.
A_analytic_literature.route_disposition: Historical manuscript citation inventory. The current proof uses the proposition-level Grauert assumptions recorded on M_actual_lifting and a direct depth-two module argument on M_analytic_counterexample. It does not depend on the unavailable Demailly source or assert that source is false.

A_algebraization_literature.statement: Unexamined external algebraization inputs: Artin approximation Theorem 1.10, Hironaka section 3 Theorem 3.3, Artin Theorems 3.8-3.9, Cutkosky Proposition 2.1(1), and Stacks tags 00IN,07QY,07QZ,04GN,06LJ,0A1W,00MC,07NV,07NY,0C23.
A_algebraization_literature.route_disposition: Historical unexamined-citation inventory, superseded on the active route by proposition-level assumptions on the AG claims. The original approximation, equivalence and excellence sources and the required Stacks statements have now been read. New independent source attribution remains pending.

A_kodaira_literature.statement: Unexamined input: Biswas-Gurjar-Kolte Theorem 0.1(1), used to exclude logarithmic Kodaira dimension at most one for the claimed singular surface with free tangent sheaf.

A_blowup_literature.statement: Unexamined input: universal property of module blowups, cited to Barajas-Chavez-Martinez-Romano-Velazquez section 1.6, Theorem 1.17 and the discussion after Introduction Question 1.

J_order2.statement: For the fixed volume-preserving first two steps, the four vertical obstruction tests equal epsilon_ij times (sum_j(W_j-1)+9 deg L)/12; the symmetric tests vanish by the global residue theorem for P_i P_j.
J_order2.engineer_result: Conditional proof supplied; the inside and outside total matrices both equal [[0,-15/2],[15/2,0]].

J_order3.statement: After interpolating A_2 and incorporating the old order-one transition, adding lambda_j/z_j to h_3 and 3 lambda_j r/z_j to the disk B_3 preserves all equations through determinant degree three and changes the vertical obstruction by 3 sum_j lambda_j r'(q_j); this map is surjective.
J_order3.engineer_result: Explicit right inverse for a nonzero two-row minor; old-transition terms and the still-unimposed degree-four equation are accounted for.

J_order4.statement: After simultaneous field matching at order four, the degree-four determinant-target obstruction is represented by -dh_4. The leading order-four horizontal generator is an intrinsic scalar, and each contour residue of this exact differential is zero.
J_order4.engineer_result: Scalar covariance of h_4 and zero contour integral of -dh_4 established without meromorphic-extension assumptions.

J_induction.statement: With targets compatible two determinant degrees ahead of imposed equations, interpolation of A_(k-1), horizontal matching, vertical splitting and target extension work for every k>=3. For k>=4 the vertical obstruction vanishes, and for k>=5 the target obstruction vanishes by negative-degree Serre duality. Every fixed field coefficient stabilizes after the following step.
J_induction.engineer_result: Quantified induction for every k, with two target degrees reserved and coefficientwise formal stabilization after the following step.

J_all_orders.statement: For every data set satisfying the stated curve and residue hypotheses of prop:jets, and every integer N>=2, there exist compatible overlap transitions and field rows through index N with A wedge B=t^2(1+O(t)). In fact the coupled construction has a coefficientwise stable formal limit with determinant target G sigma^-1. This is a conditional existence theorem, not an analytic convergence or algebraization theorem.
J_all_orders.engineer_result: The conditional theorem was accepted in the existing bounded Reviewer receipt bf979be90014. That completed review is reused, not repeated; it is not approval of the new CT_joint_inputs claim or of downstream analytic claims.

J_independent_review.statement: An independent Reviewer has replayed the exact certificate, read the quantified proof and statement fidelity, checked relied-on citations, and accepted the bounded result.
J_independent_review.scope_note: Receipt review.status=done applies to the bounded conditional jet theorem only; it is not approval of CT_joint_inputs.

J_significance.statement: The manager-owned publishable significance and verified-new novelty boundary has been met. A verification of this bounded implication alone does not establish this.
